RACK.name: INIT
RACK.about: RACK I/O only: the empty rack.

RACK.name: Acid Line
RACK.about: BUSHIDO plays a 12-step acid line on the host clock (1/16) into RONIN's ACID LINE voice: row A's pitch goes through RONIN's INT, which slides between notes, GATE A fires EG 1 (VCA) and EG 2 (filter snap), and row C (C MODE CV) is the accent on VCF CUTOFF.

RACK.name: Acid Fold
RACK.about: A 12-step acid line through ORIGAMI. RONIN's ACID SQUELCH voice: row A's pitch slides through INT, GATE A fires EG 1 and EG 2, row C (C MODE CV) accents VCF CUTOFF, and EG 2's filter snap also folds harder through ORIGAMI's VC 1.

RACK.name: Driving Bass
RACK.about: An 8-step rolling 16th bass, one bar of 4/4 on the host clock: TRIG 9 patched into RESET makes BUSHIDO's 12 steps an 8-step loop. RONIN plays a short saw with a little resonance; ORIGAMI adds drive that keeps the low end clean.

RACK.name: Pluck Lead
RACK.about: An 8-step pluck lead on the host clock (TRIG 9 -> RESET). Row A spans RANGE 5 V, quantized to semitones; RONIN's pulse wave has its width moved by the MG, and a fast EG 1 plucks the filter. ORIGAMI adds bite.

RACK.name: Two Voices
RACK.about: One BUSHIDO plays two RONINs: row A is the bass on CV A, row C a counter line on CV C (C MODE CV, 0..5 V = five octaves). GATE A fires both envelopes. RONIN 1's MIX sums its own voice (IN 1) and RONIN 2 (IN 2) into its OUTPUT, and the pair plays through ORIGAMI.

RACK.name: Stepped Fold
RACK.about: BUSHIDO sequences the fold as well as the notes: row C (C MODE CV) drives ORIGAMI's VC 1, so every step has its own fold depth, and TRIG 5 kicks VC 3 once a loop. RONIN is a held saw drone gated by GATE A.

RACK.name: MIDI Fold Synth
RACK.about: Play RONIN from your DAW: RACK I/O's MIDI NOTE, GATE and VEL jacks drive RONIN's VCO, EG 1 and filter, and RONIN plays through ORIGAMI. Send MIDI to the JIDAI RACK track.

RACK.name: Acid Drum Jam
RACK.about: Every unit: SHOGUN plays a four-on-the-floor kit clocked from RACK I/O (CLK 1/16 -> CLK IN, RESET -> RST IN). BUSHIDO plays a 12-step acid line into RONIN's ACID DRIVE voice (INT slides, row C accents), ORIGAMI folds it. Drums and bass meet at MAIN OUT, where the rack lines them up to the sample.

RACK.name: Full EDM Jam
RACK.about: Every unit, host-clocked: SHOGUN plays kick, clap, hats, open hat and a tom fill plus a lead riff on its own LEAD synth. BUSHIDO's 8-step bass (TRIG 9 -> RESET) plays RONIN. SHOGUN's whole mix runs through ORIGAMI as a glue fold on the bus; the bass joins at MAIN OUT, where the rack lines it up with the drums.

RACK.name: Filter Fold FX
RACK.about: An insert effect for your track: host audio from RACK I/O goes through RONIN's resonant filter, swept by the MG, then through ORIGAMI, and back to the host.

RACK.name: Tempo Gate FX
RACK.about: A tempo-synced gate for your track: RACK I/O's TRANSPORT CLK 1/16 fires RONIN's EG 1 on every 16th, which opens VCA 1 on the host audio; ORIGAMI folds the chopped signal. Runs while the DAW plays.

RACK.name: EDM Starter
RACK.about: Every unit, host-clocked and locked: SHOGUN plays kick, clap and hats, and its bar pulse (RST OUT) restarts BUSHIDO on every downbeat. BUSHIDO plays an acid line into RONIN (INT slides, GATE A fires both envelopes, row C accents the filter). ORIGAMI folds RONIN's filter before VCA 1, and the kick's envelope, inverted by RONIN's MIX, ducks the bass in VCA 1. Drums and bass meet at MAIN OUT.
